blocks.text: Hotelier Sherap Gurung of Lokpa, the gateway village and permit checkpoint for the popular Tsum Valley trekking area in northern Gorkha district, woke early on Sunday to a growing rumble from the Syarkhola stream below his house. When he stepped outside at dawn, he saw water surging through the stream with an unfamiliar roar. He rushed inside, woke his wife and children, and alerted the tourists staying at his hotel before leading everyone to higher ground. Footage posted on social media shows a torrent of black mud and rocks hurtling downhill, destroying structures as residents scream, flee their homes and scramble […]...
